comment: kiln.items v6, equipment sets (dev.28 dossier chapter 10; package 10-equipment-sets, built in dev.29): the commit's own rollback conditions, captured from the first bytes of items/InventoryCommit. The commit rolls the whole transaction back by itself when the setup flags byte (tx+0xb0) has bit 0x40, or when the InventoryEmptyState accessor (tx+0xa0) is empty while the touched-inventories count (tx+0x7148) is not 0; a set refuses before calling the commit when either holds. The same bytes on server 26430253 (0x1af874) and client 26430625 (0x40fe44), so the client composes this file unchanged. A game update that changes these conditions stops the pattern from matching and turns items.equip_sets off. Every other symbol is the baseline's (items.json).

@items/CommitGuards.comment: InventoryCommit: test byte [rcx+guard_flags],0x40; mov r13,rcx; jne rollback; cmp qword [rcx+empty_state],0; lea rbx,[rcx+touched_count] (then cmp qword [rbx],0; je go on; call rollback)
